from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,base64
p=Path.cwd()
for src,page,name in [('williams.pdf',5,'williams848'),('williams.pdf',6,'williams849'),('zigzag.pdf',12,'original12'),('zigzag.pdf',13,'original13')]:
